purpose: library: bubble sort — the compare-adjacent-pairs/swap/repeat-until-no-swaps procedure stated as steps, its O(n^2) complexity for arbitrary data versus approaching Θ(n) for nearly sorted lists, the pass-shrinking improvement, its 'sinking sort' name origin, and how bidirectional bubble sort and gnome sort improve on it. Fits step ordering of the passes, a compare table with quicksort, and quiz cards on the two complexity cases.
